name: beiyun-30min
description: 备孕 30 分钟每日训练 · Nuxt 静态站点

scripts.build:server: npm run build:dist && node scripts/sync-web.mjs && cd server && go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w" -o ../bin/beiyun-server ./cmd/server
scripts.serve:server: cd server && BEIYUN_ADDR=:8787 BEIYUN_DB_PATH=./data/app.db go run ./cmd/server
